question:
Find the area of the shaded region of the diagram, where ACDF is a rectangle, AC = 90 cm, AF = CD = 20 cm and ED = 10 cm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3799f6683702cb2212ade2e8bd8073fd411f6840b5e30d0609418f3ee926f339.png]
solution:
**Concept:**

Area of Rectangle = Length × Width.

Area of Triangle = 1/2 × Height × Base

**Solution:**

Area of rectangle ABCD

⇒ AC × CD = 90 cm × 20 cm

⇒ 1800 cm².

Area of triangle FBE

⇒ 1/2 × FE × AF 

⇒ 1/2 × 80 cm × 20 cm = 800 cm².

Shaded area = Area of rectangle ABCD - Area of triangle ADE

⇒ 1800 cm² - 800 cm² = 1000 cm².

**Therefore, the area of the shaded region is 1000 cm².**
